an5.218:1.3: appasannā nappasīdanti pasannānaṃ ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti satthu sāsanaṃ na kataṃ hoti pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati cittamassa nappasīdati
an5.218:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā apāsādike.
an5.218:2.3: appasannā pasīdanti pasannānaṃ bhiyyobhāvo hoti satthu sāsanaṃ kataṃ hoti pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati cittamassa pasīdati
an5.218:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā pāsādiketi.
